Evaluating structured debt and green hospitality funding for East African biodiversity corridors.

documents.title: One-Page Investor Teaser
documents.description: High-level visual executive summary of the hospitality-led agro-tourism opportunity, landholding, and capital requirements.
executiveHighlights: Fixed US$2.4M capital target with US$980k (40.8%) allocated to greener ecosystem & productive assets
8.0 ha owned today + ~7.0 ha adjacent option in negotiation (15 ha total)
Prime wildlife adjacency: bordering Lewa Conservancy (UNESCO rhino stronghold) & Ol Pejeta Conservancy
Unlevered project IRR of 14.8% and 2.85x equity multiple over 10-year horizon

documents.title: Investor Brief — 5-Minute Overview
documents.description: Decision-useful executive briefing on project background, concept architecture, land logic, and investor milestones.
executiveHighlights: Comprehensive synthesis of verified project facts ($2.4M, 12–15 suites, 15 ha total)
Strategic conservation geography bordering Lewa and Ol Pejeta with permeable wildlife corridor design
Full 12-category Sources & Uses schedule with $980k / 40.8% greener ecosystem subtotal
10-year pro-forma highlights: ADR ramping $380 to $560, occupancy 35% to 68%

documents.title: Investor Presentation Deck
documents.description: Master slide deck covering destination context, competitive landscape, accommodation typologies, and financial thesis.
executiveHighlights: 20 visual slides formatted for presentation to investment committees
Macro tourism data for Laikipia conservancy and safari circuits
Spatial masterplan overlays and accommodation architectural renders
Series A Preferred Equity investment summary & governance terms

documents.title: Master Investment Case
documents.description: Detailed institutional thesis detailing hospitality economics, agricultural integration, target demographic, and risk matrix.
executiveHighlights: 10 comprehensive sections covering macro context, land assembly, unit economics, and circular utilities
Regional analysis: Segera bordering Lewa and Ol Pejeta rhinos and apex predator sanctuaries
Greener ecosystem deep dive ($980,000 / 40.8% of Capex): microgrid, biogas, hydrology, animals, and retail
Institutional risk matrix with 7 risk categories and minority shareholder protections

documents.title: Conceptual Site & Infrastructure Plan
documents.description: Spatial masterplanning, circulation engineering, and off-grid utility sizing brief for the consolidated 15-hectare platform.
executiveHighlights: Full spatial allocation across 15 ha with dedicated greener ecosystem & productive infrastructure schedule
60 kWp solar PV + 120 kWh LiFePO4 battery storage + 10k L/hr solar borehole + biogas digester
Segregated circulation: Guest Serenity, Farm Operations, and BOH Service networks
Precision drip irrigation network across 5.3 ha and reed-bed greywater recycling

documents.title: Visual Investor Board & Moodboard
documents.description: Visual direction portfolio illustrating proposed material palettes (volcanic stone, cedar, thatch, canvas) and guest experiences.
executiveHighlights: Material board featuring local Segera stone, sustainable timber, and natural canvas
Guest pavilion interior moodboards with private savannah viewing plunge pools
Farm harvest larder and dining pavilion concept visuals
Wellness deck and infinity pool integrated into indigenous acacia landscape

documents.title: Concept Storybook & Brand Vision
documents.description: Brand narrative exploring the journey from an integrated pastoral farm to a world-class destination agro-resort.
executiveHighlights: The farm as the living classroom: farm-to-table culinary philosophy
Harmonious coexistence of agriculture, wildlife corridors, and guest luxury
Highland wellness concept: botanical therapies, dark-sky astronomy, and trail runs

documents.title: 10-Year Illustrative Financial Model
documents.description: Dynamic spreadsheet with 10-year pro-forma statements, room yield modeling, departmental opex build-ups, and scenario toggles.
executiveHighlights: Interactive workbook with sheets: Read Me, Inputs, 10-Year Model, Sources & Uses, Scenarios
Conservative base-case ramping to $3.33M gross revenue and $1.07M EBITDA in Year 10
Downside Case (8.4% IRR, 1.9x MOIC) vs Upside Case (18.2% IRR, 3.4x MOIC)
Unlevered project cash flow modeling with corporate tax and depreciation schedules

documents.title: Sources & Uses Verification Worksheet
documents.description: Turnkey schedule reconciling the US$2.4M capital target across land, infrastructure, construction, FF&E, and contingencies.
executiveHighlights: Full 12-line verified Sources & Uses budget reconciling the fixed US$2.4M capital target
Explicit US$980,000 (40.8%) subtotal for circular utilities, productive agriculture, catering & farm shop
Itemized allocations: Land $320k, Solar $160k, Biogas $80k, Irrigation $240k, Swales $120k, Animals $80k, Fleet $60k, Suites $720k, Catering/Shop $240k, FF&E $140k, Permits $120k, Contingency $120k
Independent Quantity Surveyor (QS) certification milestone disbursement triggers

documents.title: Investor Data Room Index & Diligence Tracker
documents.description: Master index and tracking matrix of all legal, corporate, land title, planning, environmental, and technical diligence items.
executiveHighlights: 24 categorized diligence items across corporate, land, technical, design, and regulatory
Clear status flags: official land registry searches verified, hydrogeological survey ready
Document custodians, clearance tier mappings, and file formats
Statutory NEMA EIA and County Government physical planning tracker

documents.title: Reconciliation & Diligence Status Checklist
documents.description: Operational and technical diligence status tracker including water survey, soil testing, planning permissions, and infrastructure scoping.
executiveHighlights: Technical survey checklist: 0.5m contour topography, geotechnical bearing, solar simulation
Water rights and borehole drilling permit status under Water Resources Authority (WRA)
Road access easement verification connecting to the main Segera arterial route

documents.title: Investor Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
documents.description: Authoritative answers to 20 critical commercial questions regarding capital requirements, unit counts, water security, and land title.
executiveHighlights: Definitive answers on why preliminary $10.8M / 24-unit models were superseded
Question 16 breakdown: US$980k (40.8%) dedicated to greener ecosystem & productive infrastructure
Water security: 10,000 L/hr solar borehole + 200,000L buffer = 45 days reserve
100% off-grid clean energy: 60 kWp solar PV array + 120 kWh LiFePO4 batteries
Exit strategy: trade sale, regional PE buyout, or dividend distributions

documents.title: Indicative Term-Sheet Framework
documents.description: Institutional discussion template outlining Series A Preferred terms, governance rights, Board seats, and Reserved Matters.
executiveHighlights: Series A Preferred Equity with 8.0% cumulative accrued coupon during construction
Pre-money valuation of US$1.2M; post-money valuation of US$3.6M (66.7% investor equity)
Reserved Matters schedule: 8 key corporate actions requiring 75% shareholder approval
Information rights: Monthly KPI flash reports, quarterly financials, annual audited IFRS

documents.title: 90-Day Capital-Raising Plan
documents.description: Structured capital formation timeline moving from initial outreach and lead-investor alignment to technical diligence and close.
executiveHighlights: Phase 1 (Days 1–30): Lead investor identification and term sheet alignment
Phase 2 (Days 31–60): Confirmatory legal, technical, and QS cost diligence
Phase 3 (Days 61–90): Definitive legal execution, escrow funding, and close

documents.title: Investor Outreach Communication Guide
documents.description: Standardized outreach protocol and introduction framework for prospective co-investors, family offices, and strategic partners.
executiveHighlights: Tailored email messaging for institutional funds, family offices, and strategic operators
Follow-up cadence and data room onboarding protocol
Confidentiality agreement (NDA) workflow and tier upgrade instructions

documents.title: Investor Pitch Script & Founder Guide
documents.description: 10-minute presentation narrative, slide-by-slide speaker notes, and anticipated Q&A speaking guide for project leadership.
executiveHighlights: Word-for-word opening hook addressing the owned land starting asset
Compelling transition from traditional high-overhead safaris to agro-resort hospitality
Direct talking points for explaining the $2.4M budget discipline and 14.8% IRR

documents.title: V3 Master File Manifest & Notes
documents.description: Official release notes for Version 3.0 package, explicitly documenting superseded unit figures and validation protocols.
executiveHighlights: Formal release notes harmonizing all project figures to US$2.4M and 12–15 units
Full repository file manifest matching the physical disk storage structure
